segments.name: Public Safety Technology and Services
segments.description: Provides integrated non-lethal tools, training, and digital evidence solutions for law enforcement, corrections, defense, and other public safety organizations worldwide.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as a single operating and reportable segment in accordance with ASC 280, Segment Reporting.

revenueModel.text: Public safety agencies and other customers pay the company for non-lethal products, accessories, VR and digital training subscriptions, professional services, training, and shipping.
revenueModel.evidence: Product sales include BolaWrap products and accessories. Other revenue includes VR revenues, professional service, training and shipping revenues.

changes.text: In 2023, the company acquired Intrensic, LLC, adding body-worn camera and digital evidence management capabilities.
changes.evidence: In August 2023, we acquired Intrensic, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("Intrensic"), which added body‑worn camera ("body-worn cameras" or "BWC") and digital evidence management ("digital evidence management" or "DEM") capabilities to our portfolio.
